mainpictures3.title2: I am proud to invite you

detailCase1.2679: Small spaces often pose big challenges. It was no different with the design of a small studio for my client. The apartment is located in an old tenement house. Originally it consisted of a bathroom, kitchen and living room. Our main task was to separate a sleeping area and arrangement of space to be functional, comfortable and beautiful.
detailCase1.3681: the small bedroom has been separated from the living room, with windows facing north. The new bedroom has no windows, so instead of the TRADITIONAL wall, we have proposed a folded glass wall, which perfectly illuminates the room and can be folded if necessary, thus opening the space The bedroom has a double bed, a bedside table and a wardrobe. The wall is decorated with a beautiful Boudoir Navy WallArt wallpaper that goes all the way to the living room
detailCase1.3683: in the living room we have replaced the traditional window with a wallet window, which illuminates the interior. The old wardrobe has found its use as a bookcase, while the armchair from the 1960s inherited from my grandparents fits perfectly into the style of the apartment. The bright sofa looks beautiful against the Boiduar navy wallpaper, and wooden accessories give the interior coziness.
detailCase1.3685: the kitchen is simple and elegant. Bright colors with the addition of wood and the green motif on the walls repeated throughout the apartment. Hanging cabinets are glazed, which gives the kitchen a light and elegant touch.

detailCase2.2260: Private house for a family of three
detailCase2.2321: I present the project of the total metamorphosis of the house from the 1970s. The owners are a young couple with a small child.
detailCase2.2918: a large area of ​​the living room is divided into a seating area and a dining room. The interior of the living room and dining room is modern, but the décor refers to nature: wallpaper with a motif of leaves, wooden floor and furniture, old brick by the wall with a fireplace, leather sofas - make that the interior is cozy and very comfortable - perfect for a young family.
detailCase2.3405: this realization of the project shows how a small renovation can cause huge changes. From an unsightly and uncomfortable room, it has become an ideal place to rest and relax. This project is a perfect example of HOME STAGING - a small renovation and adding decorations make the bedroom it has become cozy, elegant and at the same time increases the value of the property.
detailCase2.3406: a small toilet and a dark color on the walls? Why not? Dark walls and ceiling make the room seem higher than it really is.

detailCase.2613: Large space and many possibilities. I present to you a house plan with separate zones for the kitchen, living room and dining room.
detailCase.3210: is the heart of the house. Here you spend most of the day, prepare meals here - a place that should not only be unique, but also ergonomic and practical. In the place of the designed kitchen there was a small, impractical room here - after the walls were demolished and to open the space, we have a wonderful kitchen with custom-made furniture, a built-in refrigerator and an oven. Two pull-out cargo wardrobes are a perfect place for storage and the multitude of cabinets and drawers will satisfy the most demanding lady of the house. and the cooker hood and wooden accessories constitute a compositional whole. The kitchen is comfortable and beautiful at the same time
detailCase.3697: were an important element of interior design for my clients, which is why I decided to use a vertical garden in a coffee zone separated from the living room. The vertical garden is a unique element, referring to nature, but also cleverly placing a large collection of plants in one place. in the coffee area there is also a 3-seater honey sofa, two comfortable armchairs and a table. Next to the coffee corner, there is another space:
detailCase.3698: A bright, comfortable couch with a chaise longue, a comfortable armchair and a table - this is almost everything you need in a TV corner. I placed the TV on a wall covered with old recycled wood planks. Here also a reference to nature, but not only - wooden the cladding on the wall is also a way to mask the lighting and cables needed to connect the RTV equipment. The whole is complemented by accessories and fabrics that make the interior cozier and elegant.

detailCase3.2260: An apartment for a young married couple
detailCase3.2317: Can an attic apartment become a dream enclave for two? Of course! I present the design of an attic apartment
detailCase3.2914: The project included a small apartment in the attic of a tenement house. From an old, non-functional apartment, I created a beautiful, comfortable and ergonomic interior ideal for young people. Open spaces, natural colors and materials used make the interior cozier and light.
detailCase3.3401: by demolishing the walls, the apartment gained the space it needed. Covering the fireplace with stone gave it a new life and the interior gave it character and coziness. Wooden furniture and accessories, as well as subdued colors - refer to the nature and colors of the earth.
detailCase3.3402: Due to the lack of hanging cabinets - the lower cabinets are mainly drawers, it is also a great solution for an ergonomic space. Dark green tiles bring color to the interior and blend in beautifully with the cabinets and the countertop. .
